messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — flying Warsaw -> Berlin next Tue for a customer visit. Quick Q on per-diem + foreign cash receipts.
James Ortiz: Are per-diems pro-rated if you leave after lunch? Also, can I claim an ATM withdrawal used for a taxi if I lost the taxi receipt?
Maya Chen: Short answer: partial travel days are pro-rated; full overnight travel days get full per-diem. See policy: https://intranet.redwood/te/per-diem (flag for finance to confirm country table)
Priya Kapoor: ATM cash is tricky — we prefer itemized receipts. If taxi receipt is lost, upload a photo of the booking/ride history + card statement showing the charge OR a short note explaining and your manager's approval. Use `lost-receipt-form` in the expense form.
Elena Mendez: Also: if you're using cash for many small things, consider using the daily per-diem instead of trying to reconcile dozens of tiny receipts. Check the country per-diem rates table in the policy before selecting 'per-diem'.
James Ortiz: Got it. What about app rides (Bolt/FreeNow) where tip is a separate cash option? If tip was cash, how do I claim?
Priya Kapoor: App-based rides: if tip was paid via card in-app, include the ride receipt/screenshot. If tip was cash, photograph the tip (not ideal) and add an explanation + manager approval; we'll review. Tips are reimbursable within reason.
TravelBot: Reminder: company card preferred for all bookings. Missing itemized receipts > $25 require manager note. Use tag `Warsaw-Trip` when submitting.
Maya Chen: One more — hotel paid on personal card — reimbursable, right? I have folio + booking confirmation.
Elena Mendez: Yes — reimbursable. Upload the hotel folio (itemized), booking confirmation, and expense claim with manager sign-off. If incidental charges are separate, itemize them.
James Ortiz: Thanks everyone, I'll submit tonight with screenshots and the manager note. @Priya @Elena — I'll ping you if anything is missing :thumbsup:
Priya Kapoor: Perfect, thanks. We'll process once everything is in.
